name: Naming Rule.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
STH=CENTEC High-Speed Network Series
C=100G
X=10G
G=1G
F=Fiber
E=Ethernet
P=PoE+(30W)
PB = PoE++(90W)
O=Octuple
Q=Quadruple
D=Double
OC=800G
QC=400G
QX=40G
DX=25G
XF=10G Fiber
XE=10G Ethernet
XP = 10G Ethernet with PoE+(30W)
XPB = 10G Ethernet with PoE++(90W)
VE=5G Ethernet
VP = 5G Ethernet with PoE+(30W)
VPB = 5G Ethernet with PoE++(90W)
DF=2.5G Fiber
DE=2.5G Ethernet
DP=2.5G Ethernet with PoE+(30W)
DPB = 2.5G Ethernet with PoE++(90W)
GF=1G SFP
GE = 1G Ethernet
GP = 1G Ethernet with PoE+(30W)
GPB = 1G Ethernet with PoE++(90W)
HSI=Hot Swappable Input
FI=Fixed Input
SFI=Single Fixed Input
DFI=Dual Fixed Input
Example
STH-32C-HSI, that is 32*100G fiber ports, hot-swappable input
STH-8C48XF-SFI, that is 8*100G fiber ports+48*10G fiber ports, single fixed input
EB=Standard License
MS=Advanced License
MA=Specific License(Metropolitan Area Network)
ST=Stacking License
Typically, MS license will do
